title: Finisar’s (FNSR) Buy Rating Reiterated at William Blair - Markets Daily
text:
Posted by Mitch Edgeman on Mar 5th, 2018 // No Comments 
Finisar (NASDAQ:FNSR) ‘s stock had its “buy” rating reiterated by analysts at William Blair in a note issued to investors on Monday. 
The analysts wrote, “We expect the company to come in roughly in line on revenue with a downward bias to EPS due to ongoing datacom pricing pressure affecting gross margin. The Street is looking for $333 million on revenue (roughly flat sequentially) and $0.23 for EPS; we are in line on revenue and a penny below consensus on EPS. We believe the company could see modest quarter-over-quarter expansion in 3-D sensing (revenue is relatively small to be affected by recent Apple [AAPL $176.21; Not Rated] iPhoneX cuts) offsetting ongoing inventory correction in China (at Huawei and ZTE) and product transition at hyperscale customers (Amazon [AMZN $1,500.25; Outperform] transitioning from 40G to 100G). The biggest risk to Finisar remains gross margins, which could remain pressured until datacom pricing stabilizes, cost reduction products become available, and/or higher-margin products (CFP2-ACO and ROADMs) begin to ship in volume.”” Get Finisar alerts: 
A number of other brokerages have also recently commented on FNSR. Piper Jaffray Companies lifted their price objective on shares of Finisar from $22.00 to $28.00 in a research note on Wednesday, December 13th. DA Davidson restated a “buy” rating and issued a $30.00 target price on shares of Finisar in a report on Wednesday, November 29th. Raymond James Financial set a $26.00 target price on shares of Finisar and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, December 19th. Zacks Investment Research upgraded shares of Finisar from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Thursday, February 8th. Finally, Stifel Nicolaus lowered their target price on shares of Finisar from $27.00 to $23.00 and set a “buy” rating for the company in a report on Wednesday, December 6th. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, six have assigned a hold rating, eleven have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $27.02. Finisar ( FNSR ) opened at $18.15 on Monday. Finisar has a 52 week low of $16.64 and a 52 week high of $35.25. The company has a market cap of $2,069.54, a price-to-earnings ratio of 10.37, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.96 and a beta of 1.02. The company has a quick ratio of 6.31, a current ratio of 7.81 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.44. 
Finisar (NASDAQ:FNSR) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, December 7th. The technology company reported $0.23 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $0.20 by $0.03. Finisar had a net margin of 14.33% and a return on equity of 9.51%. The business had revenue of $332.21 million during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $331.69 million. sell-side analysts anticipate that Finisar will post 0.66 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.

Following the sale, the executive vice president now owns 69,150 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,500,555. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 62,578 shares of company stock valued at $1,273,865 in the last quarter. 1.02% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.

Finisar Company Profile 
Finisar Corporation (Finisar) is a provider of optical subsystems and components that are used in data communication and telecommunication applications. The Company’s optical subsystems consist of transmitters, receivers, transceivers, transponders and active optical cables, which provide the fundamental optical-electrical or optoelectronic interface for interconnecting the electronic equipment used in these networks, including the switches, routers, and servers used in wireline networks.
